capture_clock_policy.host_clock_samples: date +%s.%N immediately before and after the device clock command
capture_clock_policy.event_rule: Map every recognized log event to the host epoch timeline and accept it only when its full uncertainty interval is inside the exact Artemis session step window and strictly after the first feature tap. Reject a capture cursor whose latest possible host time is after the first tap.

case_goals.tinos-demo-allow-then-interval-denial: Run only the Tinos positive case with runner feefd94c72dbce0fa1afc109ffe3d8254f565d6b, profile pro, app com.dualix.dualmessenger.webscanner, test ad IDs only, placement main, a 20-second minimum interval, and a 3-shows-per-hour cap. Use a fresh cold start; do not clear app data. Complete only the presented Splash/UMP consent, Language First-Open, Privacy Ack, Forced Re-Login, and Onboarding screens; never enter personal credentials or invent account state. Report NOT-RUN if Home requires personal data or is unavailable. Dismiss the automatic Premium paywall with Android system Back without purchase. Confirm Home and visible DiscountBadge (non-premium); select WhatsApp using home-tab-whatsapp and confirm home-screen-2 plus home-screen-2-feature-direct_message. Start the reviewed exact-serial TinosDemo capture wrapper before cold start; do not start another logger or clear buffers. The verifier reads exactly two tap timestamps from this same session's steps rows for tap actions on home-screen-2-feature-direct_message. The executor reads first-visible and close-control timestamps from the recording, normalized to the same host epoch; those are the only action-time verifier inputs. Tap the feature once and close its displayed ad with the visible close control within 15 seconds of first visibility, or report NOT-RUN. Require `show allowed: shown and dismissed`; if absent after a close within 15 seconds, report NOT-RUN for the show-call timeout race. Require `revenue <valueMicros> micros <currency> unit=ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/1033173712 network=<network> precision=<precision>` or report FAIL: revenue_event_missing. Return Home exactly once with Android system Back and confirm the same WhatsApp feature selector. Let D be first-ad visible duration, t1 the first exact allow-log timestamp, and t2 the second session tap timestamp. Tap a second time only if `t2 - t1 <= 15 seconds - D` and `(t2 - t1) + D + 5 seconds <= 20 seconds`; 5 seconds covers up to 4 seconds for second fill and 1 second timestamp uncertainty. If `15 seconds - D <= 0`, clocks cannot align within ±1 second, Home does not return, or the window is missed, report NOT-RUN and do not tap late. Require `show denied by Tinos rules (NOT_ALLOWED)` after t2. If two allow lines and no denial occur inside the verified window, report FAIL with reason `gate_allowed_inside_interval`; outside the window report NOT-RUN. Fill failures `not loaded; skipping` and `show failed (<code>)` are neither allow nor denial; report NOT-RUN. Preserve same-session Checker and runner-bound final-capture identity. If capture or Artemis is SIGKILLed, the wrapper trap may not stop logcat; confirm the recorded logger PID is gone before device release. Do not execute the negative control.
case_goals.tinos-demo-first-click-negative-control: Run only the Tinos negative control with runner feefd94c72dbce0fa1afc109ffe3d8254f565d6b, profile pro, app com.dualix.dualmessenger.webscanner, test ad IDs only, placement main, a 20-second minimum interval, and a 3-shows-per-hour cap. Use a separate fresh cold start; do not clear app data. Complete only the presented Splash/UMP consent, Language First-Open, Privacy Ack, Forced Re-Login, and Onboarding screens; never enter personal credentials or invent account state. Report NOT-RUN if Home requires personal data or is unavailable. Dismiss the automatic Premium paywall with Android system Back without purchase. Confirm Home and visible DiscountBadge (non-premium); select WhatsApp using home-tab-whatsapp and confirm home-screen-2 plus home-screen-2-feature-direct_message. Start the reviewed exact-serial TinosDemo capture wrapper before cold start; do not start another logger or clear buffers. The verifier reads exactly one tap timestamp from this same session's steps rows for a tap action on home-screen-2-feature-direct_message. The executor reads first-visible and close-control timestamps from the recording, normalized to the same host epoch; those are the only action-time verifier inputs. Tap the feature exactly once and close its displayed ad with the visible close control within 15 seconds of first visibility, or report NOT-RUN. Require `show allowed: shown and dismissed`; if absent after a close within 15 seconds, report NOT-RUN for the show-call timeout race. Require `revenue <valueMicros> micros <currency> unit=ca-app-pub-3940256099942544/1033173712 network=<network> precision=<precision>`; missing revenue makes the control invalid, not a pass or intended failure. Fill failures `not loaded; skipping` and `show failed (<code>)` are neither allow nor denial and make the control invalid. Any `show denied by Tinos rules (NOT_ALLOWED)` invalidates the one-tap control. Make this exact final Checker assertion intentionally false: `The first Direct Message feature click must be denied by Tinos rules (NOT_ALLOWED).` The only valid control result is fail_assertion for this assertion, with allow and revenue observations present, all other final assertions passed, and same-session Checker and runner-bound final-capture identity. If capture or Artemis is SIGKILLed, the wrapper trap may not stop logcat; confirm the recorded logger PID is gone before device release. Do not execute the positive case.

runtime_values_only: attempt-root: a new empty evidence directory for this case
case-goal: the complete matching case_goals string above, submitted verbatim as one argv element; do not replace it with a journey filename
case-id: the exact matching case id above
Sol-granted-exact-serial: the exact serial in Sol's issue-visible grant
fresh-UUID: a new UUID per case, reused as both session and run ID
observed-artemis-exit-status: the exact foreground Artemis process exit status
The verifier derives exactly one control tap or exactly two positive taps from this session's steps rows matching action tap and target home-screen-2-feature-direct_message.
first-visible-epoch: recording time normalized to the native host-epoch timeline; positive-only input
closed-epoch: close-control time normalized to the native host-epoch timeline; positive-only input
log-event-epoch: device epoch timestamp mapped to host epoch with capture metadata and uncertainty
entry_point.collection: Run in the foreground; preserve the complete wrapper, runner, and verifier argv and environment, stdout/stderr, logger PID and stop status, cursor, runner and verifier exit statuses, trace directory, timestamped raw TinosDemo logcat, and same-session Checker ledger and runner-bound final capture. Control requires exactly one matching session feature tap; exit 1 with JSON fail_assertion is valid only for the intended false assertion; control exit 2 with NOT-RUN means the allow line is missing after the timeout race; other control exit 2 outcomes are invalid_control. Positive mode requires exactly two matching session feature taps. Exit 0 is PASS, exit 10 is FAIL, exit 11 is NOT-RUN, and exit 12 is INVALID-EVIDENCE. Two allow lines and no denial inside the verified timing window return exit 10 FAIL with gate_allowed_inside_interval and a separate revenue_observation field; outside the window returns exit 11 NOT-RUN before event-count classification. Both modes require Artemis exit status 0 and session-bounded timestamped evidence. If the foreground command is SIGKILLed, the wrapper trap may not stop the exact logger PID; confirm that PID is gone before device release. Do not run if execution would incur new spend.

testcase_side_tool.purpose: Validate timestamped Tinos events and same-session Checker/final-capture identity for positive and negative-control modes.

testcase_side_log_capture.purpose: Start exact-serial TinosDemo logcat with a device-epoch start cursor before Artemis, record host clock samples around the device clock probe, refuse to launch Artemis if logcat does not remain running during startup, and stop the recorded logger PID on every exit path.

revision_policy.rule: Any change to the pinned runner, app commit or APK digest/size, candidate journey, candidate manifest, command argv, case goal, selector, assertion, fixture/reset, timing threshold, verdict adapter, or evidence requirement creates a new candidate revision. Both independent non-author reviews must approve the same new revision before execution. Evidence does not transfer across candidate, runner, app, or APK revisions. No execution evidence exists until an authorized run is completed and Sol verifies the report.
